summary: TimetableAssessments manages workflows, rules, and UI for adding, editing, validating, and deleting assessment configurations for a given timetable. Features include dynamic configuration of assessors, subjects, assessment types/templates, and optional sections; role-based access; validation of assessment logic; and handling UI states and error/warning displays.
purpose: To enable authorized users to configure assessment types, templates, and settings—including visibility/access permissions and scheduling logic—per timetable, and to manage the lifecycle (add, edit, delete) of assessment records, subject to business validation.

workflows.name: Add Assessment Entry
steps: Screen switches to Add mode and displays FormView.
User populates fields (dropdowns, checkboxes, text fields) for assessor, subject, assessment type/template, open/close days, permissions, optional sections.
Save action triggers validation and entry is persisted; details panel is hidden.
Grid refreshes to display new entry.

workflows.name: Edit Assessment Entry
steps: FormView populates with existing values for editing.
System validates and updates the record; panel is hidden and grid refreshed.

workflows.name: Delete Assessment Entry
steps: On confirmation, entry is deleted and grid refreshes.

workflows.name: Validation Workflow
steps: On data bind, assessment validation checks for: interim without final, instructors/supervisors overlap, assessment maximum exceeded.
Validation errors are shown in designated error panel.

workflows.name: Optional Section Assignment
steps: When assessment template or type changes, check for optional section existence using current selections.
If present, assign relevant assessor and update UI to show information.

business_rules: Only authorized users (SystemAdministrator, PlacementCoordinator with LocalAdministrator) may edit assessments.
Assessment types, templates, and optional sections are dynamically loaded based on timetable context.
Interim assessments must be paired with a final assessment.
No overlap between instructor and supervisor assessments.
Assessment maximum may not be exceeded.
Assessor permission to view subject answers is restricted for 'Student' assessor type.
Subjects can view assessor answers only when subject type is 'Supervisor' and assessment type is 'Final'.
validations: Required fields: Assessor, Subject, Assessment Type, Assessment Template, OpenDaysAfterStart, CloseDaysAfterEnd
Day fields must be numeric values (validators applied).
CloseDaysAfterEnd must not precede the current date relative to placement end/start.
Validation summary and custom validators shown in UI.
calculations: End date for closing: start or end date of placement plus CloseDaysAfterEnd.
Visibility periods computed using ViewUntilDaysAfterEnd and placement dates.
conditions: Screen is editable if user is not ViewOnly and is SystemAdministrator or PlacementCoordinator with LocalAdministrator.
Optional section controls visible only if relevant template/type combo exists.
CheckBox for 'AssessorCanViewSubjectsAnswers' hidden for 'Student' assessor type.
SubjectsCanViewAssessorAnswers visible only when subject is Supervisor and assessment type is Final.
system_behavior: On page load, scripts for assessments and dates are registered.
GridView shows/hides Add button, handles row commands, and updates UI.
Panels for errors and warnings shown/hidden based on validation outcome.
Popup FormView modal used for entry details.
dependencies: Assessment templates: filtered by timetable ID.
Code lists: code records for assessors, subjects, types.
User session data for role access and query string parameters.
Business-layer methods for search, add, update, delete, validate.
exceptions: Validation errors: interim without final, instructor/supervisor overlap, assessment maximum exceeded.
JavaScript errors prevented by custom handling of empty data templates.
content_gaps: UI labels, resource (localization) values, and some called business-layer methods (e.g. search, add, update, delete) not fully defined.
Some referenced JavaScript functions and server controls are assumed but not explicitly included.
